name: White Rabbit Creamy Candy (大白兔奶糖)
blurb: Shanghai's milk candy wrapped in edible rice paper, made since 1959 under the rabbit logo
title: White Rabbit Candy (大白兔): History and Edible Wrapper
description: White Rabbit Creamy Candy (大白兔奶糖) is a Shanghai milk candy with an edible rice-paper wrapper, sold under the rabbit logo since 1959 and still made today.
answer: White Rabbit Creamy Candy (Da Bai Tu) is a chewy milk candy from Shanghai, made today by Guan Sheng Yuan. It began in 1943 as "ABC Mickey Mouse candy", a copy of an English milk toffee, and took on its leaping-rabbit wrapper in 1959. Each piece is wrapped in a thin edible layer of rice paper inside the printed wrapper. It has never stopped being made and is exported widely.

body: Each candy is a small, off-white cylinder: soft, chewy and strongly milky, closer to a milk toffee than a hard candy. Under the printed paper wrapper with its leaping white rabbit is a translucent film made from glutinous rice. It is meant to be eaten and melts on the tongue, though many children peeled it off without knowing.

head: Year
What happened
rows: Shanghai's ABC Candy Factory copies an English milk candy, sold as ABC Mickey Mouse candy
The factory is nationalised and renamed; a white rabbit replaces Mickey Mouse
The rabbit packaging launches on 1 October as a gift for the PRC's 10th anniversary; the factory later merges into Guan Sheng Yuan
During Nixon's visit to China the candy is given to the Americans (accounts differ on whether to Nixon or his advance team)
Sales of about 600 million yuan, exported to over 40 countries
Recalled in several countries during the melamine milk scandal; the maker later resumed sales and exports
Collaborations: lip balm, perfume, milk, ice cream

body: White Rabbit is still in production. Guan Sheng Yuan belongs to the Shanghai state-owned Bright Food group, and the candy is a common sight in Chinese supermarkets and in Asian groceries abroad.

From the late 2010s the brand leaned into nostalgia: a 2018 White Rabbit lip balm with the cosmetics brand Maxam sold out its first batch of 920 almost at once, a perfume line followed in 2019, and White Rabbit-flavoured milk and ice cream came in 2019 and 2020.

ul: Not knowing the clear inner wrapper was edible
Bowls of it at Chinese New Year and in wedding candy bags
Candy stuck to the teeth after a long chew
Saving the wrappers between book pages

faq.q: Can you eat the White Rabbit wrapper?
faq.a: The inner translucent layer, yes: it is edible rice paper. The outer printed paper wrapper is not.
Shanghai's Guan Sheng Yuan, part of the Bright Food group.

faq.q: When was White Rabbit candy invented?
faq.a: Its predecessor dates to 1943 in Shanghai; the White Rabbit brand and wrapper appeared in 1959.
